content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: The notice asks for attested copies of these documents with the application: One blank envelope with a Rs. 5/- postal ticket must also be attached to the application.

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Applicants submit the filled application in the prescribed format, with the attested copies of the required documents, on 25 November 2026 between 11:00 AM and 2:00 PM at the 2nd floor, Health Department, Zilla Parishad, Dhule. Applications are accepted only within this period; none is accepted afterwards. The same date and time are printed for all three posts. The application form is printed on pages 4 and 5 of the notice. Exact name of the post applied for, name, father's / husband's name, date of birth, blood group, gender, marital status, nationality, religion and category. Present and permanent address with district name and PIN code, contact number and e-mail ID for correspondence. Demand draft bank name and number, languages known (English, Hindi, Marathi, others), and computer proficiency. Academic / professional education summary, work experience summary (responsibilities in 30 to 50 words), total and relevant experience, and notice period / joining time in days. Details of internships, workshops, conferences or trainings, a photograph, and a signed declaration. All fields are mandatory; an incomplete form is treated as rejected. The form's disclaimer says the National Ayush Mission is not responsible for late receipt or non-receipt of applications for any reason, and applications received after the due date and time are not considered.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The notice says that the selection process depends on the number of applications received. Applications are scrutinised, a merit list is prepared on marks, and selection is made by merit. Candidates attending certificate verification / interview are not paid any travel allowance. Selected candidates receive appointment orders. The notice prints this criteria for "Specialist, Medical Officer MBBS". The notice also says that only experience under government, semi-government and the National Health Mission / National Ayush Mission will be considered in the selection process. Posting is given by merit order. If a candidate uses any kind of pressure, the candidate's selection is cancelled.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Fill the application form in the prescribed format printed in the notice. Attach attested copies of the required documents. Attach the Rs. 150/- demand draft in the name of "District Ayush Society, Dhule." Attach one blank envelope with a Rs. 5/- postal ticket. Submit the application on 25 November 2026 between 11:00 AM and 2:00 PM at the 2nd floor, Health Department, Zilla Parishad, Dhule. Submit a separate application for each post. When applying for more than one post, give the priority order of the posts to the office before the interview.

content_sections.heading: Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: The posts are contractual and very temporary. The notice describes the appointment as 11 months 29 days, ending 29 June 2026 as printed. If the government rejects the posts, the service of the candidates ends without any prior notice. The posts are not regular posts of the state government. There is no right to permanency, government service rules do not apply, and there is no right to absorption in regular government service, service protection or any claim related to it. A consolidated honorarium is paid every month. A candidate cannot ask for a change of place of posting during the contract period.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The number of vacant posts and the place of posting may change. All rights on this rest with the Chairman (Selection Committee) and the Chief Executive Officer, Zilla Parishad, Dhule. The recruitment process may be postponed, cancelled or changed by the same authorities, and no one can make a claim on this. The notice also lists the process of publishing lists, receiving objections and issuing appointment orders. Details will be published from time to time on www.arogya.maharashtra.gov.in , and candidates should note this. Candidates should not come to the office to enquire about the recruitment.

faq.question: Q1. What is the date, time and venue for NAM Dhule recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted on 25 November 2026 between 11:00 AM and 2:00 PM at the 2nd floor, Health Department, Zilla Parishad, Dhule (Tal. Dist. Dhule).

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in NAM Dhule recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies: one each for Ayush Medical Officer (PG), Yoga and Naturopathy Expert and Pharmacist, all in the open general category.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the Ayush Medical Officer (PG) post?
faq.answer: The qualification printed is MD (Ayurveda - Kayachikitsa / Panchakarma). The council registration certificate must be attached.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for the Yoga and Naturopathy Expert and Pharmacist posts?
faq.answer: For Yoga and Naturopathy Expert it is BNYS/MCIM/NCIM registration / Paramedical Council registration, or M.Sc/B.Sc Yoga or MA Yoga. For Pharmacist it is B.Pharm / D.Pharm.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for NAM Dhule recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the open category is 38 years on the day of the advertisement. The notice prints no minimum age.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for these posts?
faq.answer: A consolidated monthly honorarium is paid: Rs. 60,000/- for Ayush Medical Officer (PG), Rs. 28,000/- or Rs. 20,000/- for Yoga and Naturopathy Expert, and Rs. 20,000/- for Pharmacist.

faq.question: Q7. Is there an application fee?
faq.answer: Yes. A demand draft of Rs. 150/- must be attached, in the name of "District Ayush Society, Dhule."

faq.question: Q8. Which documents must be attached?
faq.answer: Attested copies of educational certificates and marksheets, school leaving / date of birth certificate, 2 passport photographs, government experience certificate, small family certificate, police character verification certificate and the council registration certificate, plus a blank envelope with a Rs. 5/- postal ticket.

faq.question: Q9. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Applications are scrutinised, a merit list is prepared and selection is made by merit. The marking scheme is 50 marks for educational qualification, 20 for additional qualification and 30 for experience, out of 100.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: No. The posts are contractual and very temporary, are not regular state government posts, and carry no right to permanency.
